title: use systemd unit name for healthcheck units
body:
# Description

closes #29373 

 The issue asks for healthcheck units to use the quadlet service name instead of using the container ID with a random suffix.

This change uses the PODMAN_SYSTEMD_UNIT label to get the service name of the quadlet container and uses it to create the healthcheck unit name.

For example:

quadlet-collabora.service
→
quadlet-collabora-healthcheck.service
quadlet-collabora-healthcheck.timer

If the PODMAN_SYSTEMD_UNIT label is not available or is empty, the existing container ID-based naming behavior is kept as a fallback.

## Testing

Added unit tests to verify that healthcheck units and startup healthchecks use the quadlet service name, along with the existing fallback behavior.
